description: Table session scenarios: scripted TableSession commands on a virtual clock with one seeded Mulberry32 stream, and partial render-state excerpts after each expect step. The reference table controller is DOM-bound and cannot run headlessly, so this file is authored from the UI behavior spec and verified by both native suites.
